_note: Music and sound effects fetched from Openverse (api.openverse.org) on GitHub Actions. Change a query to get a different sound; delete a line to use the code-generated version. 'licenses': cc0 and pdm need no credit; add 'by' to allow tracks that need a credit (written to CREDITS.txt). Music tries every query with cc0/pdm first, then 'fallback_licenses' (credit required, written to CREDITS.txt). Remove fallback_licenses to never use credit-required music.
